title: Count Dooku
franchise: Star Wars: Attack of the Clones
description: Once the Padawan of Master Yoda, Count Dooku was a revered and respected Jedi in the Order but became disillusioned with it. Falling out of the light and into the dark, Dooku became the apprentice of Darth Sidious, taking the name Darth Tyranus. He helped orchestrate the creation of the clone army and the entire impetus for the Clone Wars.
